name: Dao law

subjectOf.text: Higher regulatory compliance depends on a DAO adopting an appropriate legal wrapper, such as an LLC or a foundation structure, and complying with the regulations of its jurisdiction.
subjectOf.abstract: Higher scores indicate the use of appropriate legal wrappers, such as LLC or foundation structures
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Market Meta Analysis 2024 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5254152
scope_conditions: DAOs that need to interact with real world legal entities

subjectOf.text: Adopting a conventional corporate form in a jurisdiction that does not recognize DAOs yields only partial legal protection; Silo Finance is registered as an LLC in Texas, but Texas does not recognize DAOs.
subjectOf.abstract: Registered as an LLC in Texas, it offers some legal protection, but Texas does not recognize DAOs (R: 5)
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Market Meta Analysis 2024 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5254152
scope_conditions: DAOs incorporated in jurisdictions lacking DAO specific recognition
